crossing_lamp_signal — DRIVE crossing op

• Data kinds: none → any (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.crossing_lamp_signal(t, *, t_on: 'float', t_off: 'float', flash_per_min: 'float' = 50.0, duty: 'float' = 0.5, exposure: 'float' = 0.0) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import drivecrossing; drivecrossing.crossing_lamp_signal(t, *, t_on: 'float', t_off: 'float', flash_per_min: 'float' = 50.0, duty: 'float' = 0.5, exposure: 'float' = 0.0) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("crossing_lamp_signal"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

2 灯の赤色せん光灯の明るさ(0..1)を時刻 t(配列)で返す: 形 (n, 2)、列 0 = 左、列 1 = 右。

1 灯の周期 P = 60 / flash_per_min、点灯 duty·P。右の灯は P/2 遅れ(解釈基準「交互に点滅」)。点くのは

[t_on, t_off)。`exposure` > 0 ならカメラの露光 [t, t + exposure] の平均(点灯時間の原始関数で閉形式)。
